name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Jacobi
instructions: Enter through the Emergency Department doors on Pelham Pkwy South. Tell the front desk you're here to warm up — no appointment needed.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Lincoln
instructions: Use the main entrance on East 149th St. Security will walk you to the warming area off the main lobby.

name: Lincoln Warming Bus
instructions: The bus parks by the Emergency Department entrance on Morris Ave. Knock on the front door if it's closed.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/North Central Bronx
instructions: Enter on Kossuth Ave. Elevator to the 2nd floor waiting room is on your right.

name: The Living Room Drop-In Center
instructions: Ring the buzzer at the Barretto St door. Showers and hot meals available.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Kings County
instructions: Enter Building A from Clarkson Ave. Warming area is past the security desk on the left.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/South Brooklyn Health
instructions: Use the Ocean Pkwy entrance. Ask for the warming room at the information desk.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Woodhull
instructions: Enter on Broadway under the J/M/Z tracks. Warming area is on the ground floor.

name: The Gathering Place Drop-In Center
instructions: Entrance is up a short flight of stairs. Staff can help with the step if needed.

name: Coney Island Stillwell Warming Bus
instructions: The bus waits on Surf Ave at the Stillwell Av subway entrance.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Bellevue
instructions: Enter through the main lobby on 1st Ave. The warming area is on the ground floor next to the café.

name: Bellevue Warming Bus
instructions: The bus parks on 1st Ave between E 27th and E 28th St, across from the main entrance.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Harlem
instructions: Use the Lenox Ave entrance at 135th St. Security will direct you.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Metropolitan
instructions: Enter on 1st Ave at 97th St. Warming area is in the main lobby.

name: 9th Avenue Drop-In Center
instructions: Entrance is on 9th Ave between 51st and 52nd St. Lockers available.

name: Olivieri Drop-In Center
instructions: Ring the bell at the street-level door. Hot drinks available all night.

name: Paul's Place Drop-In Center
instructions: Enter through the courtyard gate to the left of the main door.

name: Penn Station 32nd Street Warming Bus
instructions: The bus parks on 7th Ave at W 32nd St, outside the station entrance.

name: Penn Station 34th Street Warming Bus
instructions: The bus parks on 7th Ave at W 34th St, across from McDonald's.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Elmhurst
instructions: Enter on Broadway. Ask for the warming area at the main information desk.

name: Elmhurst Warming Bus
instructions: The bus parks by the Emergency Department entrance on Baxter Ave.

name: NYC Health + Hospitals/Queens
instructions: Use the main entrance on 164th St. Warming area is in the ground floor lobby.

name: Queens Hospital Warming Bus
instructions: The bus parks by the Emergency Department entrance off Goethals Ave.

name: Queens Drop-In Center
instructions: Entrance is on Atlantic Ave, near the 102nd St corner. Ramp on the right side.

name: Union Hall Drop-In Center
instructions: Ring the buzzer at the Union Hall St door. Short walk from the Jamaica Center subway station.

name: Project Hospitality Drop-In Center
instructions: Walking distance from the St. George Ferry Terminal. Enter on Richmond Terrace.
